Class Equipements

java.lang.Object
entities.equipements.Equipements
Direct Known Subclasses:
Armes, Soins
public abstract class Equipements extends Object
Abstract class representing an equipment item in the game.

An Equipements object corresponds to any interactable or collectible in-game object (e.g., weapons, resources). It stores basic metadata such as its name, unit count, sprite path, and position on the map. Each equipment also maintains a reference to the GamePanel for drawing and updating.

Subclasses are expected to implement custom drawing and update behavior.
